notablePrerequisites: At least three creatures have died this turn.
description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nevinyrral.
Nevinyrral enters the battlefield, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that's died this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Zombies, adding {3}.
Repeat.
